categories.name: Love & Dating
categories.title: Love & Dating Quizzes
intro: Crushes, chats, mixed signals, kilig and dating habits can turn even a simple message into a whole story.
Explore Hi Classmate’s Love & Dating quizzes to discover how you react to attraction, jealousy, communication, red flags and the little situations that make relationships interesting.

These games are made for fun and self-reflection, not professional relationship advice. Play a quiz, compare your result with your friends and see how differently everyone handles the same situations.

categories.name: Friends & Social
categories.title: Friends & Social Quizzes
intro: Every friend group has its planner, comedian, observer, storyteller and person who somehow knows everything before everyone else.
Friends & Social quizzes explore the small roles people naturally take in classrooms, barkadas, family chats and everyday social situations.
Find your role, share the result with your group and see whether your friends agree with the personality the quiz gives you.

categories.name: Pinoy Life
categories.title: Pinoy Life Quizzes
intro: Videoke nights, merienda decisions, rainy commutes, fiestas, family moments and everyday habits can say a surprising amount about the way we live.
Pinoy Life brings together Hi Classmate games inspired by familiar Filipino situations and culture.
These quizzes are playful rather than serious measures of identity. They are designed to turn everyday Pinoy experiences into something you can play, compare and share.

categories.name: Personality
categories.title: Personality Tests
intro: Sometimes the easiest way to understand a personality is through an unexpected question.
Would you keep the memory? Take the offer? Escape to a quiet island? Talk about what you feel or wait until the fog clears?
Hi Classmate personality tests use everyday decisions, imaginative situations and playful metaphors to turn your choices into a result worth reading and sharing.

categories.name: Story & Choices
categories.title: Story & Choice Tests
intro: Step into a story and let your choices reveal where it leads.
These tests use symbolic scenes, imagined places and small decisions to create a personality result at the end of the journey.
There are no correct paths. Choose what feels natural, follow the story and see which ending or portrait your decisions create.

categories.name: Challenges
categories.title: Quick Challenges
intro: Not every Hi Classmate game is a personality test.
Quick Challenges test reaction speed, memory, observation and knowledge through short games you can finish in just a few minutes.
Try to beat your own score, challenge a friend and see whether your second attempt is actually better than your first.
